messages:
Aisha (CS): Heads up — AcmeCo QBR next Wed (10:00 PT). I'm seeing a weird onboarding burn pattern for two of their new teams, could we pull a short token-econ slide (prompt vs completion, embedding calls, and regen rates)? cc @Sam C @Jess
Sam C: On it. I can pull 14-day token breakouts and a 90-day spend forecast. Quick ask: do we want raw token counts or cost-normalized view for execs? :thinking:
Jess: Cost-normalized for execs, raw counts + top prompts for enablement folks. Also: onboarding checklist shows team B hasn't completed fine-tune opt-in — possible regen driver. :eyes:
Sam C: putting numbers here — 14d window (USD billed, projected next 30d):
```
current_month_to_date: $18,450
14d_burn: $9,820
30d_projection (trend): $21,700
top_5_endpoints: chat.v2, embeddings.1, rerank.beta
prompt_tokens_pct: 38%
completion_tokens_pct: 62%
``` 
Marco (FinOps): Those numbers map to a 2.1x spike vs baseline — renewal risk if they hit commit tiers. Recommend budget alert at 65% of their reserved credits and an onboarding check call. Link to cost dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/acmeco-cost
Jess: Also capture qualitative feedback: customer reported "unexpected regen on multi-turn flows" — tagging @eng-runtime for possible prefix caching issue.
Aisha (CS): Action items: (1) @Sam C  — finalize token-econ slide (cost-normalized + raw counts) by Tue COB; (2) @Jess — collect top 10 prompts and onboarding status; (3) @Marco (FinOps) — set budget alert 65% and prepare commit-impact note. I'll assemble 3-slide QBR deck and send draft by Tue EOD. 
QBR-bot: Deck export ready -> /shared/qbrs/acmeco-1769991234.pdf
Sam C: noted, will upload token CSV to shared drive and ping here when done. :white_check_mark:
Jess: I'll schedule a prep run-through Wed 9:00 PT. If eng-runtime can't confirm caching fix, we'll propose short-term rate-limits or smaller context sizes as mitigation.
Marco (FinOps): I'll also include a cost-sensitivity table showing impact of 10/25/50% regen reduction.
Aisha (CS): Perfect — thanks team. I'll update the QBR agenda and tag renewal AE for visibility."
